'''''Star Wars: Princess Leia''''' is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries written by [[Mark Waid]] and penciled by [[Terry Dodson]]. The five-issue series, published by [[Marvel Comics]] from [[March]] to [[July]] [[2015]], centers on the character [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The series addresses how Leia deals with the [[Destruction of Alderaan|destruction]] of [[Alderaan]], her [[homeworld]], as she tries to find survivors of the attack that are scattered across [[the galaxy]].<ref name="SDCC Comics Announced" />
